core.title: Modern 4 Inch Address Letters, Deltana RNB-L
tags: Deltana B Series Modern Font Address Letters

text.description_html:
Deltana RNB-L, Modern Series B Stainless Steel 4 Inch House Letters

The Modern 4 Inch Address Letters are available in apartment letters A, B, C, and D as well as in the directional letters N, S, E , and W. The Modern Series B Stainless Steel 4 Inch House Letters can be flush mounted or can be mounted with a 11/16 inch projection using the included stand-offs. The Deltana Series B Address Letters come packaged with surface mount hardware. Choose from brushed stainless steel or matte black finishes.

Also Available Matching Address Numbers

Specifications and Features of the Deltana B Series Modern Font Address Letters:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Height: 4"
  • Thickness: .275"
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware for surface mounting.
  • Can be mounted flush or floating.
  • There are variances in height for specific digits. Please CLICK HERE to see the specifications of each letter (PDF)
